site.name: Vasanthan E
site.role: Full stack engineer and founder of VarSys
site.heroTitle: I build and run the software
site.heroLead: Full stack engineer and founder of VarSys. I take products from the first conversation to a deployed, maintained system: interface, API, database, mobile builds and the servers they run on. Eight of them are live today.
site.aboutText: I started VarSys to solve problems I had at home and in my own restaurant, and kept building until the tools were good enough for other people. Today I work with clients the same way: understand the real workflow, ship a usable first version early, and stay on to run it.
site.contactText: Tell me what the software should do and who will use it. I reply within one working day with questions or a suggested first step.

expertise.title: What I can build for you
expertise.lead: Five areas I work in every day. Pick one to see how I approach it and the live products where it already runs.

products.title: Eight products in production
products.lead: Built, deployed and maintained by me under VarSys. Each card checks its site from your browser right now, so you can open any of them and use the real thing.

work.title: Projects delivered for clients
work.lead: Websites, booking systems, assessment platforms and desktop tools for restaurants, a doctor, a psychology practice and small businesses. Open a project for the problem, the solution and the timeline.

plan.title: Shape your project in a minute
plan.lead: Choose what you need. The summary on the right shows how I would approach it and which live products already do something similar. Send it as a brief when it looks right.

products.name: VarSys Store
products.line: Every VarSys app, in one place.
products.about: The release portal for the whole suite: Android and Windows downloads, always the latest build, with notes, sizes and dates for every release.

products.name: Joint Journey
products.about: One money book for a household: shared expenses and income per person, budgets, receipts, vehicles, loans, statement import and trips.

products.name: TraQify
products.line: Log the day. Read the year.
products.about: Money, health and routine in one tracker: investments and loans, calorie goals and workouts, habit streaks, and a Focus Hub with Pomodoro.

products.name: VoltTrack
products.line: Know every unit before the bill does.
products.about: Every electricity meter in one place. Reads bill PDFs automatically, charts usage, handles meter resets and prices by tariff slab.

products.name: CookSuite
products.about: Kitchen costing and operations: stock, recipes, gas and power costs, sales and delivery-app payouts. Built from running a real kitchen.

products.name: EV Hub
products.about: Service platform for electric scooters and motorcycles: compare workshop prices, book a service, look up error codes and check battery health.

products.name: DocuStore
products.about: Cloud file storage for teams. Team membership decides access, enforced in the database with PostgreSQL row-level security.

products.name: Vasanth's Kitchen
products.about: The website of my own restaurant, with menu, offers and orders managed from its own admin. The kitchen behind it runs on CookSuite.

expertise.title: Multi-tenant SaaS
expertise.short: Teams, roles and data isolation done in the database.
expertise.detail: Team-scoped products where one customer can never see another's data. Access rules live in PostgreSQL row-level security, not only in the UI, and sessions come from Better Auth with role-based permissions.

expertise.title: Web + mobile + desktop
expertise.short: One codebase shipped to the browser, Android and Windows.
expertise.detail: React front ends packaged for Android with Capacitor and for Windows, with versioned releases published through my own store. Clients get one product on every device without three separate builds to maintain.

expertise.title: Data products + dashboards
expertise.short: Turning statements, bills and logs into decisions.
expertise.detail: Importers for bank statements and electricity bill PDFs, tariff and costing engines, and dashboards that answer one question each. Charts are built for the data, not dropped in from a template.

expertise.title: Bookings + commerce
expertise.short: Customer sites with ordering, booking and admin.
expertise.detail: Public sites paired with an admin app: service booking, parts catalogues, menus and offers, and payment integrations with RazorPay and Stripe for client work.

expertise.title: Self-hosted infrastructure
expertise.short: I deploy and run what I build.
expertise.detail: Every VarSys product runs on a VPS I operate: Docker containers deployed through Coolify, a private Headscale VPN for database access, secrets in OpenBao, and production PostgreSQL with least-privilege roles.

projects.title: Personal Finance & Production Management App
projects.shortDescription: Python-based dashboard with income/expense tracking, visual analytics, goal-based budgeting, attendance tracking and financial insights.
projects.fullDescription: A comprehensive Python-based financial management application that combines personal finance tracking with production management capabilities. The application features real-time data visualization, automated reporting, and integration with multiple APIs for enhanced functionality. Built with a focus on user experience and data accuracy, it serves both individual users and small businesses.
features: Income and expense tracking with categorization

technologies.name: Python
technologies.description: Core application logic and data processing

challenges.title: Real-time Data Synchronization
challenges.description: Managing real-time stock data updates while maintaining application performance
challenges.solution: Implemented asynchronous data fetching with caching mechanisms and optimized update intervals

challenges.title: Complex Financial Calculations
challenges.description: Accurate calculation of profits, losses, and financial projections
challenges.solution: Developed robust calculation engine with error handling and validation

timeline.description: Implementation of core features and database design
Integration with Google Tasks and Zerodha APIs

projects.title: Sales & Inventory Management System
projects.shortDescription: Python-based system with daily/monthly tracking, low-stock alerts, and profit/loss analysis per item.
projects.fullDescription: A comprehensive inventory and sales management system designed for small to medium businesses. Features advanced analytics, predictive modeling for stock management, and real-time reporting capabilities. The system integrates with Firebase for cloud storage and real-time synchronization across multiple devices.

challenges.title: Demand Forecasting Accuracy
challenges.description: Predicting inventory needs based on historical sales data
challenges.solution: Implemented machine learning algorithms with seasonal adjustment factors

projects.title: Facial Recognition Attendance System
projects.shortDescription: Python application using OpenCV for facial recognition-based attendance tracking with automated payroll generation.
projects.fullDescription: An advanced attendance management system that uses facial recognition technology to automatically track employee attendance. The system includes automated payroll calculation, working hours tracking, and comprehensive reporting features. Built with OpenCV for computer vision and includes anti-spoofing measures for security.

challenges.title: Facial Recognition Accuracy
challenges.description: Ensuring high accuracy in different lighting conditions and angles
challenges.solution: Implemented multiple face detection models and preprocessing techniques

challenges.title: Anti-Spoofing Security
challenges.description: Preventing attendance fraud using photos or videos
challenges.solution: Added liveness detection and multiple verification steps

projects.title: Restaurant Website Template
projects.shortDescription: Complete restaurant website with blogging page for customers and owners, showcase gallery for menu, online ordering system.
projects.fullDescription: A comprehensive restaurant website solution featuring online ordering, real-time order tracking, customer blogging platform, and administrative tools. Built with modern web technologies and Firebase for real-time functionality. Includes payment integration and customer management features.

challenges.title: Real-time Order Tracking
challenges.description: Implementing live order status updates for customers
challenges.solution: Used Firebase real-time database with WebSocket connections

projects.title: Attention Span Assessment Platform
projects.shortDescription: Website with 4 tasks to measure attention span based on reaction time, featuring authentication using Firebase, payment integration with RazorPay.
projects.fullDescription: A comprehensive psychology assessment platform designed to measure and analyze attention span through interactive tasks. The platform includes user authentication, payment processing, subscription management, and detailed analytics for both individual users and organizations.

challenges.title: Accurate Reaction Time Measurement
challenges.description: Ensuring precise timing measurements across different devices and browsers
challenges.solution: Implemented high-resolution timing APIs with device calibration

challenges.title: Subscription Management
challenges.description: Creating flexible subscription plans for different organization sizes
challenges.solution: Built modular subscription system with customizable features

projects.title: Doctor's Website with E-commerce
projects.shortDescription: Comprehensive website for a doctor with online booking and consultation features, integrated with an e-commerce platform for selling ayurvedic medicines.
projects.fullDescription: A complete healthcare website solution combining medical consultation services with e-commerce functionality. Built on the Wix platform, it features appointment scheduling, patient management, online consultations, and an integrated store for ayurvedic medicines with inventory management.

challenges.title: Integration Complexity
challenges.description: Seamlessly integrating booking system with e-commerce functionality
challenges.solution: Used Wix APIs and custom workflows to connect different modules

challenges.title: Medical Compliance
challenges.description: Ensuring the website meets healthcare industry standards
challenges.solution: Implemented privacy policies and secure data handling practices
